Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 93. Category: form. Full Strength.

Transformation
This Transformation can be learned by anyone as a
rank 3 technique. You buff your body through energy
manipulation and fight disregarding the energy drain.
Increase your Power by 2
You gain an additional +1 to your AC.
You gain +1 Bulk
At the end of your turn, you lose 3 Stamina
